title: Tribal Movements Kol Uprising
definition: The Kol Uprising (1831-32) was a massive tribal insurrection in the Chota Nagpur region, primarily driven by the dispossession of tribal lands by outsiders (Dikus) and the imposition of exploitative colonial revenue systems.
importanceInUpsc: It serves as a classic case study for 'Tribal Resistance against Colonialism' in GS Paper I (Modern History), highlighting the intersection of land alienation, cultural erosion, and administrative failure.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Tribal Movements Kol Uprising.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
